  "phoneNote": "Strong workshop photography and readable typography make a convincing introduction, but the two-column price grid leaves an awkward empty quadrant and uneven label wrapping.",
  "desktopNote": "The photographic hero feels appropriate to the craft, but contact access is buried below the opening screen and the lower sections are unnecessarily tall.",

  "fixes": [
    "Add a clearly visible click-to-call link in the desktop header so visitors can contact the workshop without scrolling to the footer.",
    "Reduce desktop section padding, especially around opening hours, and scale down the oversized footer wordmark to shorten the journey to contact details.",
    "Present mobile prices as three full-width rows with service labels on the left and prices on the right, eliminating the incomplete grid and inconsistent wrapping."
